name: UnSub (CAIRN operator, US aerospace) — GTIG
description: GTIG observed the open-source multi-agent pentest framework CAIRN (OODA loop, shared "blackboard" between specialized agents) used in live intrusion activity against targets including a US aerospace organization. *Analyst note: separate from the already-tracked Cairn user in the UnSub (Strix/Cairn/Hermes) row; GTIG gives little operational detail, no dates and no MITRE IDs. Vendor source.* GTIG
